name: Mizushima Ushio
source:
Ushio is a shy introvert. She loves to swim, and can move better in water than on land. According to [url=/c98254]Ikari[/url], she gives off a nice scent. She mostly wears her personal white swimsuit while she's swimming.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
